# GameHub client

`gamehub.ts` is GameHub's typed client, copied unchanged from
[ArndRosemeier/gameserver](https://github.com/ArndRosemeier/gameserver) `client/gamehub.ts`
(commit bc3a987), as that repo's README says a game takes it ("copy this one file into your game").

Do not edit it here. To take a newer client, copy the file again and note the commit above.
Nauta's network code is in `src/net/` (docs/SEAMS.md); tests use the fake hub in `test/support/fakeHub.ts`.
